name: mina-safe-agent-kit
description: Deterministic safety checks and conformance fixtures for AI-assisted Mina and o1js development.

scripts.check: npm run check:static && npm run test:conformance
scripts.check:static: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test:static && npm run build && npm run evaluate && npm run profile:check
scripts.test:conformance: npm run build && vitest run tests/conformance-cli.test.ts
scripts.test:mcp-policy: npm run build && vitest run tests/profile-cli.test.ts
scripts.test:static: npm run build && vitest run --exclude tests/conformance-cli.test.ts
scripts.evaluate: node --import tsx src/cli.ts evaluate --corpus evaluations/tasks.json --responses evaluations/baseline-responses.json --mode canonical --json
scripts.profile:check: npm run build && node dist/cli.js profile generate --json
